units.source_text: 三月底，六条院内赛射，许多人前来参与。

en.t: At the end of the third month, an archery contest was held within the Rokujo estate, and many people came to take part.

units.source_text: 柏木心绪恶劣，意气消沉，

en.t: Kashiwagi was in a wretched state of mind and felt deeply dispirited,

units.source_text: 但念到恋人所居之处来看看花，亦可聊以慰情，便也来出席。

en.t: but he thought that seeing the flowers at the place where his beloved lived might give him some comfort, so he too attended.

units.source_text: 禁中赛射，原定于二月内举行，后来延期了。

en.t: The palace archery contest had originally been scheduled for the second month, but it was later postponed.

units.source_text: 三月又是薄云皇后忌月，不宜举行，因此大家引为遗憾。

en.t: The third month was also the memorial month for Empress Usugumo, making such an event unsuitable, so everyone regretted the delay.

units.source_text: 他们闻得六条院有此盛会，便照例一齐前来参与。

en.t: When they heard that this grand gathering was being held at the Rokujo estate, they all came together as usual to take part.

units.source_text: 左大将髭黑和右大将夕雾，是源氏的子婿，当然都到。

en.t: The Left General Higekuro and the Right General Yugiri were Genji's sons-in-law, so naturally both were present.

units.source_text: 其次如中将、少将等，也都前来竞赛。

en.t: Others such as middle captains and lesser captains also came to compete.

units.source_text: 原定比赛小弓，但出席者之中有好几个优秀的步弓能手，

en.t: The original plan was to compete with small bows, but among those present were several excellent foot-archery masters,

units.source_text: 便把这些人唤出来，叫他们比赛步弓。

en.t: so these men were called forward and made to compete in foot archery.

units.source_text: 殿上人之中长于此道者，也分列两旁，参与赛射。

en.t: Those courtiers who were skilled in this art also divided into two sides and joined the shooting contest.
The light of day gradually turned toward evening.

units.source_text: 今日乃春尽之日，暮霭沉沉，晚风纷乱，

en.t: This was the final day of spring; the evening mist lay heavy, and the night wind blew in restless gusts,

units.source_text: 诸人皆有“久立花阴不忍归”之感，

en.t: and everyone felt as though they could stand long in the flowers' shade and could not bear to go home,

units.source_text: 相与传杯进酒，俱各酩酊大醉。

en.t: so they passed cups around, urged one another to drink, and all became thoroughly drunk.
